fit_reason: Although marked as a private seller, the listing text and photos show this is dealer stock from Warner's Dock Inc., photographed on the dealer lot, not a private owner sale.
findings: Metalflake hull sides and gunwales are glossy with no visible oxidation or swirls
Outboard cowling is clean and shiny
Seats and deck carpet look clean and new
Trailer fenders and wheels look clean
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Ranger Z520R. It already looks sharp, with a glossy metalflake hull and clean seats. If you ever need gelcoat polishing or detailing on trade-ins or lot boats, we come to you and would be glad to give you a quote.
